question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abandon
(CGLE 2021 Tier I)
options:
Rescue

Retain

Possess

Quit
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Quit

Abandon - Quit

Explanation:
'Abandon' means to leave something or someone completely and finally, and 'Quit' also means to leave or give up something permanently.
'Abandon' का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ या किसी को पूरी तरह से और अंतिम रूप से छोड़ देना, और 'Quit' का अर्थ भी किसी चीज़ को हमेशा के लिए छोड़ देना है।

Other synonyms Words:
Forsake, Desert, Relinquish, Leave, Surrender

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Abandon – त्यागना – To leave completely and finally.
Example: 'He decided to abandon his old car and buy a new one.'

Rescue – बचाव – To save someone from a dangerous situation.
Example: 'The firefighters rescued the family from the burning building.'

Retain – बनाए रखना – To keep or continue to have something.
Example: 'She managed to retain her composure during the interview.'

Possess – स्वामित्व रखना – To own or have something.
Example: 'He possesses great knowledge about ancient history.'

Quit – छोड़ देना – To leave or stop doing something permanently.
Example: 'She quit her job to pursue her passion.'

Conclusion:
'Quit' is the most appropriate synonym for 'Abandon' as both imply leaving something permanently, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Abate
(Executive Assistant)
options: Revive
Reduce
Incite
Extend
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Reduce

Abate - Reduce

Explanation:
"Abate" means to become less intense or widespread, which aligns perfectly with "Reduce," meaning to make something smaller or less in amount.
"Abate" का अर्थ है कम होना या घटना, जो "Reduce" से मेल खाता है, जिसका अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को कम करना।

Other synonyms Words:
diminish, decrease, lessen, subside, dwindle

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Abate – कम होना – To become less intense or widespread.
Example: "The storm began to abate by evening."

Revive – पुनर्जीवित करना – To restore to life or consciousness.
Example: "The doctor tried to revive the unconscious patient."

Incite – उकसाना – To encourage or stir up violent or unlawful behavior.
Example: "His speech incited the crowd to protest."

Extend – बढ़ाना – To make longer or larger.
Example: "They decided to extend the deadline by a week."

Reduce – कम करना – To make smaller or less in amount.
Example: "We need to reduce our expenses to save money."

Conclusion:
"Reduce" is the best synonym for "Abate" because both words convey the idea of something decreasing in intensity or quantity. The other options either mean the opposite (Revive, Extend) or are unrelated (Incite).

question:

(Maharashtra Municipal Taxation and Administration Service)
options: Disgusting
Admirable
Indifferent
Harmonious
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Disgusting

Explanation:
"Abhorrent" means causing or deserving strong dislike or hatred, which aligns perfectly with "disgusting." Both words convey a strong sense of repulsion.

Example: "His abhorrent behavior made everyone uncomfortable."

Admirable – प्रशंसनीय – (Deserving respect or approval)
Example: "Her dedication to work is truly admirable."

Indifferent – उदासीन – (Having no particular interest or sympathy)
Example: "He was indifferent to the outcome of the match."

Harmonious – सामंजस्यपूर्ण – (Forming a pleasing or consistent whole)
Example: "The team worked in a harmonious manner."

Disgusting – घिनौना – (Arousing revulsion or strong indignation)
Example: "The rotten food had a disgusting smell."

Conclusion:
"Disgusting" is the best synonym for "abhorrent" as both express intense dislike or repulsion, unlike the other options which are either neutral or positive in meaning.

Extinguished – बुझा हुआ – No longer burning; put out.

Burning – जलता हुआ – On fire; in flames.
Example: "The burning building sent smoke into the sky."

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Abolish
(NBEMS RECRUITMENT 2023 Senior Secondary level)
options: Setup
Protect
Establish
Abrogate
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Abrogate

Abolish - Abrogate

Explanation:
"Abolish" means to formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution, and "Abrogate" means to repeal or do away with a law, right, or agreement, making it the closest synonym.
("Abolish" का अर्थ है किसी प्रणाली, प्रथा या संस्था को समाप्त करना, और "Abrogate" का अर्थ है किसी कानून, अधिकार या समझौते को रद्द करना, जो इसे सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची बनाता है।)

Other synonyms Words:
Annul, Nullify, Revoke, Terminate, Repeal

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Abolish – समाप्त करना – To formally put an end to something.
Example: "The government decided to abolish the outdated tax law."

Setup – स्थापित करना – To establish or arrange something.
Example: "They will setup a new office in the city."

Protect – सुरक्षित करना – To keep safe from harm or danger.
Example: "Laws are made to protect citizens' rights."

Establish – स्थापित करना – To set up or create something on a firm basis.
Example: "The company was established in 1995."

Abrogate – रद्द करना – To repeal or abolish a law, agreement, or custom.
Example: "The treaty was abrogated due to violations."

Conclusion:
"Abrogate" is the best synonym for "Abolish" because both imply the formal termination of a system or law, whereas the other options either mean the opposite or are unrelated.
(हिंदी निष्कर्ष: "Abrogate" "Abolish" का सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि दोनों का अर्थ किसी प्रणाली या कानून को औपचारिक रूप से समाप्त करना है, जबकि अन्य विकल्प या तो विपरीत अर्थ रखते हैं या असंबंधित हैं।)

solution:

"Absorb" का अर्थ है किसी चीज को लेना या सोख लेना, और "consume" का अर्थ भी संसाधनों को लेने या खपत करने से हो सकता है। दोनों शब्द किसी चीज के अंतर्ग्रहण या उपयोग को दर्शाते हैं।

Example: "Plants absorb sunlight for photosynthesis."

Dissolve – घुलना – To become incorporated into a liquid so as to form a solution
Example: "Sugar dissolves in water."

Throw up – उल्टी करना – To vomit or eject stomach contents
Example: "The smell made him throw up."

Emit – उत्सर्जित करना – To release or discharge (e.g., gas, light, sound)
Example: "The factory emits harmful pollutants."

Consume – उपभोग करना / खपत करना – To use up (resources) or take in (food, knowledge, etc.)
Example: "The engine consumes a lot of fuel."

Conclusion:
"Consume" is the best synonym for "absorb" as both imply taking in or utilizing something, unlike the other options which either mean dissolving, vomiting, or emitting.

solution:

Perplexing, Arcane, Cryptic, Esoteric, Recondite

Abstruse – गूढ़ – Hard to understand due to complexity.
Example: "The professor's lecture on quantum physics was abstruse for most students."

Obvious – स्पष्ट – Easily perceived or understood.
Example: "The answer to the simple math problem was obvious."

Transparent – पारदर्शी – Easy to perceive or detect.
Example: "Her intentions were transparent, and everyone trusted her."

Lucid – स्पष्ट – Clear and easy to understand.
Example: "The teacher gave a lucid explanation of the concept."

Complicated – जटिल – Consisting of many interconnecting parts; complex.
Example: "The instructions for assembling the furniture were too complicated."

Conclusion:
"Complicated" is the best synonym for "abstruse" because both words describe something that is difficult to understand due to complexity. The other options ("Obvious," "Transparent," "Lucid") are antonyms or unrelated in meaning.

Explanation:
"Accessible" means easy to approach, reach, or use, and "Reachable" is the closest synonym as it implies the ability to be reached or accessed.
"Accessible" का अर्थ है आसानी से पहुँचा जा सकने वाला, और "Reachable" इसका सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि यह पहुँच योग्य होने का भाव देता है।

Example: "The library is accessible to all students."

Example: "His explanation was obscure and hard to follow."

Reachable – पहुँचने योग्य – Able to be reached or accessed
Example: "The remote village is now reachable by road."

Drastic – कठोर – Extreme in effect or action
Example: "The government took drastic measures to control inflation."

Tremendous – अत्यधिक – Very great in amount, scale, or intensity
Example: "She made a tremendous effort to complete the project on time."

Conclusion:
"Reachable" is the best synonym for "Accessible" because both imply the ability to be approached or obtained easily, unlike the other options which do not convey the same meaning.
